testsuite.name: com.textpic.studio.ime.KeyboardSpecTest

testcase.name: double space inserts a period but only quickly
symbols page two matches the screenshot
every page parses and its rows line up
long press alternates come from the layout
the mode keys in the assets point where the navigation graph says
navigation follows the screenshots both ways
geometry has no overlaps and no dead gaps
password and no-suggestion fields learn nothing
numpad has the operator column, four rows and the stacked 1234
symbols page one matches the screenshot
input types pick the right page
shift behaves like a real keyboard
touching a gap still hits a key
